about.title: About Me
about.lead: Software engineer for over 11 years, working full stack with TypeScript end to end: from the product decision to the deploy on AWS.
paragraphs: On the frontend, I build interfaces in React, Next.js (App Router, Server Components and Server Actions) and Vue, with an in-house Design System, accessibility and a focus on perceived performance.
On the backend, I write APIs in Node.js, Express and NestJS applying Clean Architecture, DDD and the repository pattern, over PostgreSQL and background queues with BullMQ, Redis and SQS.

On mobile, I work with React Native and Kotlin, including white-label applications: a single codebase producing five branded apps through build flavors on Android and schemes on iOS, each with its own identifier, versioning and signing, published on the App Store and Google Play, with over-the-air delivery and production observability.
On infrastructure, I run AWS with Docker and Terraform, and keep CI/CD pipelines, observability and automated test coverage as part of the delivery rather than a separate step.

asign.title: Asign (Legacy Migration)
asign.description: Migration of a structured-PHP legacy system to a TypeScript stack with NestJS and React/Next.js, plus the AWS infrastructure and a Kotlin Android app with maps.
asign.goal: I took part in migrating a legacy system written in structured PHP to a modern TypeScript stack: a NestJS API on the backend and React with Next.js on the frontend, applying Clean Architecture, DDD and the repository pattern so that domain, application and infrastructure layers stay decoupled. I set up and run the AWS infrastructure the stack lives on, with ECS and ECR for containers, RDS, S3 and Lambda, provisioned through Terraform and shipped by a CI/CD pipeline. There I also tracked down a health check misconfiguration that let deploys report success while the previous version stayed live, and led a cost optimization effort across the account. I updated the Android application in Kotlin, adding map support and integration with the server. Report generation runs outside the request cycle, with the client consuming the result by polling instead of holding a long request open.

reportPipeline.title: Async Report Pipeline
reportPipeline.description: Background report generation pipeline that removed 504 Gateway Timeouts from heavy reports and deduplicated reprocessing.
reportPipeline.goal: Heavy reports were being generated inside the request cycle and dying at the load balancer with 504 Gateway Timeout. I designed an asynchronous pipeline: the request enqueues a job and returns immediately, background workers render the report, the result is uploaded to S3 and the client picks it up by polling. I added a SHA-256 content hash as the cache key, so identical reports are served from cache instead of being recomputed for 7 days. The timeouts disappeared, the API stopped blocking on long-running work, and redundant reprocessing was eliminated.

cacheStampede.title: Cache Stampede Fix
cacheStampede.description: Root-cause investigation of a thundering herd that took the application down in production on every cache expiration.
cacheStampede.goal: The application was going down in production on a recurring pattern nobody had connected to a cause. I traced it from the user-facing symptom to the root: every time the cache TTL expired, all in-flight requests missed at once and stampeded the database, a textbook thundering herd. The fix removed the outages, and the investigation itself is the point: an autonomous path from a vague "the app is down" to a named failure mode, with no prior map of the system. I also structured observability around it, adding a global exception filter, persisted logs and automatic Slack alerting, so the next incident is caught by the system instead of by a user.

resume.title: My Portfolio

trackmall.title: TrackMall
trackmall.description: Commercial space management platform integrated with APIs and real-time dashboards.
trackmall.goal: Led major improvements in system performance and scalability, integrating 3D maps using Three.js for commercial space visualization. Set up CI pipelines with Jenkins and Blue Ocean, implemented unit tests and code quality checks. Reduced cloud costs by optimizing AWS services (RDS, Athena, CloudWatch) and improved database performance through strategic indexing, enhancing client integrations and overall user experience.

bookaboat.title: Book a Boat
bookaboat.description: Boat booking application with search system, filters, interactive map, and admin area.
bookaboat.goal: I was responsible for architecting and developing a full-stack boat rental platform using Next.js and NestJS, applying SOLID principles and clean architecture. I implemented server-side rendering (SSR) for improved SEO, dynamic map integration for boat locations, and advanced filtering. The backend was built with a scalable REST API, JWT authentication, PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM, and a modular layered structure. I also configured CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Docker to ensure high test coverage and continuous deployment.

vxdoc.title: VXDoc
vxdoc.description: Document management system with digital signature, protocol steps, and JWT authentication.

provider.title: VisioDocX (Provider IT)
provider.description: Integration system combining spreadsheet data and AI with real-time communication via WebSocket and GraphQL in React.
provider.goal: Technical leadership in building a smart solution for spreadsheet data analysis using generative AI, integrating a real-time React interface with GraphQL and WebSocket. Overcame challenges in synchronizing multiple users and the AI while maintaining data consistency and performance. The architecture focused on scalability with Apollo Client, optimized caching, reconnection handling, and offline fallback. As a result, response time was greatly improved and user experience significantly enhanced.

dbc.title: Onboarding Clients (DBC)
dbc.description: Client management system with tech stack upgrade and implementation of unit and end-to-end tests.
dbc.goal: I led the modernization of the project’s entire stack by migrating the application to React 18, enabling support for modern features such as Suspense and Concurrent Rendering. I implemented comprehensive unit tests with Jest and end-to-end tests using Cypress, achieving production-level coverage. Additionally, I designed the testing architecture, documented key workflows, and contributed to adopting CI/CD best practices to improve deployment reliability.

helpvino.title: Helpvino
helpvino.description: Wine marketplace with CI/CD automation, test coverage, and full AWS deployment with EC2 and CloudFront.
helpvino.goal: I was responsible for the complete modernization of the project, implementing CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Blue Ocean, automated test coverage with Cypress and Jest, and integrating SonarQube for code quality analysis. Led the migration to AWS by configuring EC2, CloudFront, S3, and Route 53, ensuring scalability, security, and cost optimization. I also structured the frontend using React, standardized a modular architecture, and integrated external APIs and payment gateways.

controllab.title: ControlLab
controllab.description: Lab systems built from scratch using React, React Native, PHP, Laravel, Java, Kotlin with TDD/BDD practices.
controllab.goal: I was directly involved in the architecture and development of multiple systems from the ground up, integrating web and mobile technologies into a unified ecosystem. I built shared logic solutions using React and React Native, developed APIs with Laravel and Java, and implemented Android services with Kotlin. I applied TDD and BDD methodologies to ensure quality from day one and standardized SQL and NoSQL database integrations in scalable and high-complexity environments.
